verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs claim "versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis," and separately headcount planning backed by HRIS/ATS data, which covers the hiring-wave case. The evidence is a single one-line claim, with no description of how scenarios are built or compared side by side. Missing for 10: explicit side-by-side scenario comparison, documentation of how slipped-quarter or downside scenarios are created, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
